messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> service: billing-usage-ingest-lag (P1)
incident-bot: alert id pd-83421, runbook: Billing ingestion lag -> https://redwood/pd/alerts/83421
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident triggered: billing-usage-ingest-lag — @sara on-call
sara: ack — looking now
sara: joining call now, pd ack id pd-83421 :phone:
mike: joining. any customer impact?
kevin: seeing token counts in metering down ~2-3 hours ago, back-pressure on invoice generation. pulling logs.
lina: heads-up — finance flagged delayed invoices for a few customers on recurring billing. CS preparing comms.
sara: priority checklist: check ingest-kafka consumer lag, postgres checkpoint, metering-agg job, and runbook steps.
mike: running: `kubectl -n metering logs deploy/metering-consumer --since=15m`
mike: here's tail:
```
ERROR ConsumeLoop timeout: fetch 0 records for partition 12
WARN checkpoint commit failed: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "ck_point_pkey"
```
kevin: looks like consumer is stuck on commit; probable duplicate PK from retried messages after partial restart. saw similar after schema migration earlier.
sara: rolling restart metering-consumer to clear stuck offsets. will monitor.
sara: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer -n metering` -> initiated
incident-bot: Deployment redeploy started: metering-consumer (sha: b4c9...)
mike: after restart, consumer lag dropped from ~250k -> ~60k in ~7m, but token aggregation still off by ~12% vs expected.
kevin: token delta suggests dedupe logic skipped some messages during migration. If aggregates are missing, invoices could be undercounted.
lina: which customers affected? any invoice blockers today?
kevin: scanning invoice queue — 14 customers have invoice generation pending that require full token counts. Marked at risk.
sara: mitigation idea: switch invoice job to use raw-event fallback (read directly from raw-chunks stream) to recompute tokens for affected invoices. Heavy but bounded subset.
mike: estimate: ~10-15m per customer. can parallelize to 4 workers.
sara: ok go for it. kevin coordinate list + creds. I'm staying on call.
kevin: compiling list, will follow billing-recalc runbook. internal endpoint: `/internal/billing/recalc?cust_id=`
kevin: starting first recompute for cust_id=3571
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation note — billing-lead paged after 5m per policy (acknowledged)
lina: CS notified two SLA customers about potential delayed invoices; drafting proactive note.
mike: recompute started: logs -> "recompute tokens: cust 3571 start"; progress: 0% -> 40% in 6m.
sara: monitoring token counts; after recompute for cust 3571, tokens increased from 48,120 -> 54,900 (~14% delta). Good.
kevin: recompute for cust 3571 completed. invoice job now unblocked for that customer.
sara: spinning up additional recompute workers (scale to 4). kicking off next three in parallel: 1289, 9022, 4410.
mike: resource note: recompute is memory heavy; watch node pressure.
incident-bot: PD note: Incident updated — severity P1 (keep) until all blocked invoices unblocked and deltas validated
sara: handoff: if we see node pressure, throttle concurrency to avoid OOMs.
mike: system alert: node metering-worker-3 memory 82% — standing up extra worker.
sara: throttling concurrency to 3 to be safe; applying change now.
mike: concurrency set to 3; progress steady.
kevin: running totals: 4/14 completed, 10 remain. expected finish ~45m at current rate.
sara: preliminary root cause: schema migration + consumer restart created duplicate commit errors leaving events unprocessed. follow-ups: stronger idempotency, migration gating, backfill plan.
lina: post-incident notes for ops playbook: include customer impact timeline, CS comms log, invoices affected list.
sara: handing follow-up to ops-svcs for remediation and long-term fix. I will stay until invoices done.
ops-svcs: acknowledged. creating follow-up ticket INFRA-1120 for migration revert gating + dedupe fix.
sara: will close PD incident once all invoices unblocked and token counts reconciled.
kevin: final status: 14/14 recomputed, token deltas reconciled within 1-2% threshold. invoices generated for blocked customers.
lina: sending customer update now. thanks team :thumbsup: 
sara: thanks all. incident resolved — monitoring for 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident pd-83421 resolved by sara at 1865432450
